places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: Elmira rides a whiskey traders' boat slowly upstream as it narrows into the plains; Big Zwey kills a trader in a fight over her and the body is dumped overboard.
places.location_hint: upstream of Fort Smith, where the river leaves the trees and cuts through open plains

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Elmira slipped away from there unseen to escape being July Johnson's wife.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Where Elmira was once shown a woman rescued from Indian captivity.
